_source: SantaLucia J Jr (1998) A unified view of polymer, dumbbell, and oligonucleotide DNA nearest-neighbor thermodynamics. Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 95:1460-1465, Table 2 (unified parameters, 1 M NaCl). Salt corrections: Owczarzy R et al. (2004) Biochemistry 43:3537 (Na+, eq. 22); Owczarzy R et al. (2008) Biochemistry 47:5336 (Mg2+, eq. 16 with 18-20).
_note: dH in kcal/mol, dS in cal/(mol K) per nearest-neighbour stack written 5'->3'/3'->5' (e.g. AA/TT is 5'-AA-3' paired with 3'-TT-5'). Duplex initiation is one term per end: init_GC for an end with a G.C pair, init_AT for an end with an A.T pair. sym applies once to self-complementary duplexes.
